name: Simeon
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Simeon and Anna
cases.charge: Just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel; a widow who departed not from the temple, serving God with fastings and prayers night and day
cases.preview: Simeon was a man in Jerusalem, just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel, and it was revealed to him by the Holy Ghost that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ…
